messages:
ana: Quick sync - need final defaults for SDK telemetry: log level, request-id header, OTel propagation, redaction.

joel: My vote: default log level = WARN. Expose REDWOOD_SDK_LOG_LEVEL. Dev mode -> INFO.

priya: +1. For headers: prefer x-redwood-request-id but accept x-request-id and x-amzn-trace-id. If upstream has one, copy it; otherwise generate uuidv4 and set x-redwood-request-id. Also emit both headers on outgoing calls for compatibility.

ana: (typo) ana: tiny nit - maybe call util redwood.generateRequestId() so apps can reuse it.

joel: OTel: opt-in only. Expose config {otelEnabled, otlpEndpoint} and a simple hook onCreateSpan(span, meta). Auto add span attrs: redwood.model, redwood.request_id, redwood.input_redacted.

priya: Redaction rules: never log full prompt by default. Replace prompt with prompt_hash (sha256[:12]). Default redact patterns: bearer tokens, emails, ssn-ish, cc-like digits. Allow custom regex list via REDWOOD_REDACT_ALLOWLIST/DENYLIST.

ana: telemetry-bot: note: create RFC doc for defaults and env var table at 1719000200

joel: Also add REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG_MODE which toggles DEBUG + prints more context, but keep prompt text redacted unless REDWOOD_ALLOW_FULL_PROMPTS=true and audited.

priya: Implementation detail: do scrub at logger and at OT exporter to avoid leaks. Provide JSON logs with keys ts/level/msg/module/request_id/trace_id/span_id.

ana: ok sounds good. I'll draft the DX page and examples for node/python. Target RFC end of week. :thumbsup:
